name: MoreTry TianMa X3+ 3x3 (Triple-Magnetic + Frosted)
description: The MoreTry TianMa X3+ 3x3 (Triple-Magnetic + Frosted) ushers in a new era of flagship speedcubes, engineered for cubers who demand cutting-edge innovation and performance. This cube features a spring-tension based design for unparalleled stability and control during the fastest solves. With a groundbreaking triple-set magnet positioning system, you can experience next-level turning feel and enhanced layer alignment.
